now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#21
now.text: When Calvin Zabo's heart stops in S.H.I.E.L.D. custody, Jemma revives him with adrenaline, which accidentally completes the formula in his blood. He transforms, shrugs off the agents' I.C.E.R.s, and comes after her and the others.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who revives Cal, completing his formula by accident.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Skye's father. Jemma revives him, completing his formula by accident.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#22
proposed.text: Once Cal agrees to help stop Jiaying, Jemma treats him and reverses the changes his formula caused.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who revives Cal, then reverses his formula's changes.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Skye's father. Jemma reverses his formula's changes once he agrees to help.

changes.evidence: In S.O.S. Part Two (S2#22), after Coulson talks Cal down, Cal agrees to work with S.H.I.E.L.D.; he is placed under guard while Simmons counteracts his formula, reversing his physical changes, and he joins the mission against Jiaying. Enemy turns ally with no stage.

now.title: Runaways S1–S2#18
now.text: AWOL, a corrupt cop, shoots at Alex and Livvie at the hospital.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The corrupt cop who tries to kill Alex.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A runaway AWOL tries to kill.

proposed.title: Runaways S1–S2#19
proposed.text: Alex makes a deal with AWOL to turn on Flores and PRIDE, but AWOL double-crosses him and kidnaps Livvie to find the Runaways.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The corrupt cop who makes a deal with Alex, then double-crosses him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A runaway who makes a deal with AWOL and is double-crossed.

changes.evidence: In S2E9 (#19 counting S1's 10 episodes), Alex confronts AWOL at the restaurant, then meets him at Tamar's house and they strike a deal for AWOL to turn on Flores; AWOL double-crosses Alex, goes to PRIDE, kills Flores and abducts Livvie. A betrayal between the stages at #18 and #20.

owner_calls.question: The single Age of Ultron stage is kind enemy, but Pietro switches sides and dies fighting on Tony's side in Sokovia. Keep enemy as the through-line, or should the title leave them as allies (or get a second same-title ally stage, as Ebo and Jorani have)?
options: Add a second Age of Ultron stage (ally) for the switch to Tony's side
owner_calls.evidence: Pietro joins Ultron against Tony, then the twins turn on Ultron and fight with the Avengers in the Battle of Sokovia, where Pietro dies.
